data.title: Strategy to be removed from MSCI indexes: What are the risks for Bitcoin?
data.description: Investing.com -- MSCI confirmed on Nov 11 that Strategy Inc (MSTR) will be dropped from its global indexes, effective Dec 1. Removal doesn’t touch Strategy’s Bitcoin holdings directly. The danger is the financing chain behind them. Read more (Nov 11, 2026)
